minimalComposition.success: Bounded inspectOwnedProcess + ownsListener on exact original centerPort + health GET only after authorized spawn. Pin original runner/web records and identities, config/maintenance/Web pointer/artifact bytes, DB marker/runner identity, source; compare after. Do not call statusPreview merely for readiness because it also probes Web/profile.
minimalComposition.failure: Persist pending/confirmed center record and error/checkpoint. Never restore stale center record, retry spawn, stop runner/Web, force kill, recreate DB, rotate tokens, change maintenance, or roll back source automatically. Unconfirmed spawn ownership stays unknown; any center-only stop needs explicit approved failure policy and exact owned helper. Wrapper record alive does not prove its child/role is ready.

requiredFreshGates: Existing private configuration valid; config.runner present and original identity verified without exposing token. Database marker exists and matches original installation; never ensureDatabase/create/register paths.
